_doc: 07 §1.1 (Legend XP curve, unlock ladder), 02 §5.1a (Legend XP income), 10 §3 (Energy), 10 §8 (catch-up / frontier curve). 21 §12: the legendXp exponent is the highest-suspicion number in the whole economy — sweep it first.

runXp._doc: 02 §5.1a — BaseXp(c) = baseXpCoefficient * baseXpGrowth^(c-1). XP is a banked reward, subject to CompletionMultiplier (02 §5.2) and AD_DOUBLE_LEGEND_XP.

completionMultiplier._doc: 02 §5.2 — FinalPayout = BankedRewards * CompletionMultiplier * AdDoubleMultiplier. Death still pays: even a Stage 1 death returns 25%, never zero.

adDoubleMultiplier._doc: 02 §5.2 — AdDoubleMultiplier = 2.0 if the player watches the run-end rewarded ad, else 1.0.

energy._doc: 10 §3. 28 Part C is the authority for the Energy Reserve.

chapterGating._doc: 10 §7 — no level gate on Normal chapters.

runLifetime._doc: 14 §16.3 — a run left untouched for longer than this window is over: run commands addressed to it are refused, and the next command the player is allowed to make settles it as a death at the stage it reached. Measured from the run's OWN last accepted command, never the player's. The server's Cache:RunStateTtlHours default mirrors this number; the two must agree or a run row outlives or predeceases the rule that ends it.

catchUp._doc: 10 §8 — NEEDS DETAIL. The frontier-bonus / catch-up curve is sketched, not specified: it cannot be authored by hand and deriving it is the economy simulator's first job (O1, 21 §12). Only the two sketched endpoints below appear in the docs; the curve itself is deliberately unauthored.
